about: ECMA-262's Uint8Array.fromBase64, recorded on Node v26.11.1, over the texts test/base64.test.ts and test/base64url.test.ts read, so that those tests compare the package's readers with it on a Node that has no Uint8Array.fromBase64 (Node 24). Each set names the texts its test makes and how they are read; `texts` is how many the test makes, `read` maps each text the built-in reads to its bytes in hex, and the built-in refuses every other text of the set. On a Node that has the built-in, the tests also hold this file to it.

base64Short.case: every text of up to five of A Q B R / + = -, read with lastChunkHandling "strict"

base64NonAscii.case: a character outside ASCII in four positions, read with lastChunkHandling "strict"

base64urlStrict.case: unpadded text, padded with "=" to a multiple of four and read with alphabet "base64url" and lastChunkHandling "strict"; text holding "=" or whitespace is not read

base64urlNonAscii.case: a character outside ASCII in three positions, read as base64urlStrict reads
